title: Senior Software Engineer - Mobile Developer - PA26ITOFFQ3004
description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.

  

**Job Description**

  

**Title: Senior Mobile Developer**

**Location: Hyderabad Hybrid**

**Job Type: Full Time || Permanent**

**Job Description**

**Get To Know Us:**

SS&C GIDS provides information processing and computer software services and products. The Company’s operating segments include financial markets, customer management, professional services, and output solutions. SS&C GIDS serves the alternative investments, asset and wealth management, banking and lending, insurance, and real estate industries.

**Why You Will Love It Here!**

* Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model
* Diversity & Inclusion: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity

**What You Will Get to Do:**

As a Senior Mobile Developer, Ready to shape how our clients experience, as a Senior Mobile Developer, you will be a key player in a collaborative scrum team, working on a white label mobile app and partnering with colleagues across the APAC region. You will deliver standout mobile features and raise the bar on quality.

* Design and deliver polished mobile features, from coding and optimization to automation, while keeping everything aligned with our architectural and performance standards.
* Collaborate with the team to plan, estimate, and deliver work through backlog grooming, sprint execution, and releases to production.
* Support uplift in development practices, CI/CD automation, and AI capabilities across the team
* Foster a positive, collaborative environment to deliver robust, scalable, and pragmatic solutions.
* Champion strong engineering practices, contribute to managing technical debt, and support the team’s technical direction.
* Take shared responsibility for production health, including deployments, monitoring, and ongoing support of delivered features.
* Work with the team to identify and resolve technical risks, escalating blockers appropriately.
* Contribute to mentoring and knowledge sharing to build overall team capability.

**What You Will Bring:**

* Relevant Tertiary qualifications/degree in computer science
* Software Engineering experience at least 5+ years specifically as a mobile developer
* Experience outline below will help you succeed in this role:
  + Experience building and delivering mobile applications using React Native or native iOS/Android with modern web frameworks.
  + Strong proficiency in React Native ecosystem, including Redux (actions, reducers, sagas), hooks, and component lifecycle management.
  + Experience with frontend development experience using React and/or Angular with JavaScript/TypeScript
  + Strong backend awareness with exposure to RESTful services and Web API design/implementation.
  + Demonstrated experience with Service-Oriented Architectures (SOA)
  + Proficient in testing and quality engineering practices, including Jest, unit testing, and TDD/BDD approaches.
  + Secure coding practices
  + Experience with CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and DevOps practices
  + Hands-on experience with mobile development tooling such as Android Studio and Xcode
  Understanding of mobile accessibility standards and best practices

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

title: Product Management Intern
description:
### **General Information**


**Locations**: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
  

Role ID
216204
Worker Type
Intern \- Temporary Employee
Studio/Department
EA Mobile \- Slingshot Games (India)
Work Model

### **Description \& Requirements**


Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
**Product Management Intern – Growth \& Player Marketing**


**Location: Hyderabad (In office)**


**Duration: 8\- 10 weeks**


**About EA:**


Electronic Arts Inc. is a global leader in interactive entertainment. We develop and deliver games, content and online services across platforms. We have a broad portfolio of brands that span the most popular genres.


We exist to Inspire the World to Play. We create extraordinary new game experiences for our millions of players everywhere by bringing together talented people that combine creativity, innovation, and passion. We immerse our employees in an inclusive culture and provide opportunities for learning and leading that allows our employees to do the most impactful and rewarding work of their careers.


Join us in driving the next revolution in games.

  

  

**Help us create games players love to talk about**


EA is looking for a Product Management Intern who is curious about players, data, culture, storytelling, and what makes a game stand out. The intern will report to a PM/ SPM and work closely with game designers, developers, artists, analysts, user researchers, and marketing teams to help us understand our audiences, shape how we communicate with players, and support campaigns that introduce more people to our games and encourage existing players to keep coming back.


In this role, the intern will support the development and improvement of game features, live events, progression systems, monetization experiences, and player journeys. It will use a combination of player feedback, market research, game data, and structured problem\-solving to identify opportunities and help the team make better product decisions.


This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys games, understands what makes players return to them, and wants to learn how successful games are designed, launched, measured, and improved.

  

**Responsibilities**:

  

* Product and Creative Collaboration


	+ Collaborate with analysts, designers, engineers and artists to gather inputs, scope product requirements and communicate decisions to stakeholders.
	+ Support product managers in defining features, events, progression systems, social features, and monetization experiences.
	+ Participate in playtests, design reviews, sprint planning, and feature retrospectives.
	+ Create product collaterals to document learnings, and support teams in tracking feature scope, development progress \& utilization.
  
* Campaigns and Game Launches


	+ Help develop player communication journeys across push notifications, email, social media, community channels, and in\-game messages.
	+ Support the planning and execution of campaigns for new features, events, content updates, and game launches.
	+ Help create campaign briefs that define the audience, player insight, message, channels, and success metrics.
	+ Contribute ideas for social media content, creator partnerships, in\-game messaging, app\-store promotions, and community activations.
	+ Support A/B tests across messages, creative concepts, channels, offers, and audience segments.
  
* Market Research:


	+ Conduct competitor research \& emerging trends to identify growth opportunities and propose product features to game leads.
  
* Player Insights:


	+ Analyze game telemetry data to understand player behavior across areas such as onboarding, progression, retention, engagement, conversion, and monetization.
	+ Identify drop\-offs, friction points, and underserved player needs within the game.
	+ Understand player persona and expectations based on qualitative data from surveys, app\-store reviews, community channels, customer support, and social media.
  

**Must have:**

  

* Interest in games and understanding games as a business
  
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
  
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-moving, cross\-functional environment.
  

**Good to have:**

  

* Familiarity with free\-to\-play games, live\-service games, and mobile games, and understanding of game metrics
  
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or another analytics tool.
  
* Experience creating surveys, analyzing customer feedback, or conducting user research.
  
* Experience participating in gaming communities, esports, game jams, fandoms, creator communities, or student clubs.
  

**What Success will look like:**


During the internship, the intern should be able to:

  

* Develop a practical understanding of game development and product management lifecycle.
  
* Independently analyze a player or product problem and recommend potential solutions.
  
* Contribute to at least one feature, event, experiment, or product improvement from discovery through evaluation.
  
* Produce clear product documentation that helps cross\-functional teams make decisions.
  
* Build strong working relationships with product, design, engineering, art, analytics, and other partner teams.
  

**Sample Internship Projects**


Depending on the team’s priorities, the intern will be assigned to a game team, and they may work on projects such as:

  

* Creating go\-to\-market strategy for a new game under development
  
* Analyzing the new player onboarding funnel and recommending improvements.
  
* Conducting a competitive review of progression or social systems.
  
* Identifying causes of player churn within a specific segment
  
  

  

***About Electronic Arts***
We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.  

  

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.  

  

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: QA Analyst – Flutter Mobile & .NET Web Applications
description:

**Employer:** Confidential technology company  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Work mode:** Hybrid  
**Job type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Salary:** As per experience and interview

About the role

We are hiring a QA Analyst to test mobile and web applications and help ensure they are reliable, clear, and ready for release. The product includes a **Flutter mobile application** and a **.NET Blazor web application**, with web interfaces using **HTML and CSS**. You’ll work with developers and product team members to test features, report defects, and verify fixes.

The company and product details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

Responsibilities

* Test the Flutter mobile application on supported Android and iOS devices.
* Test the .NET Blazor web application across supported browsers and screen sizes.
* Prepare and run test cases for new features, existing functionality, and regression testing.
* Check forms, navigation, user permissions, notifications, and common error scenarios.
* Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, and expected results.
* Retest fixes and maintain concise test records.
* Review requirements and designs to identify missing states, edge cases, and unclear behaviour.
* Work with developers and product team members to investigate issues and confirm release readiness.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in software quality assurance or application testing.
* Experience testing mobile applications and web applications.
* Understanding of functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing.
* Ability to write clear test cases and reproducible defect reports.
* Familiarity with issue\-tracking tools such as Jira, Linear, or similar.
* Good communication, attention to detail, and follow\-through.

Good to have

* Experience testing **Flutter** apps on Android and iOS.
* Experience testing **.NET Blazor** web applications.
* Familiarity with browser developer tools and responsive web layouts using HTML and CSS.
* Basic API testing experience using Postman or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of SQL or databases.
* Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Appium.
* Experience testing privacy\-sensitive applications.

What we offer

* Direct collaboration with the product and engineering team.
* Opportunity to contribute to a product from its early development stage.
* Clear ownership of testing work and visibility into how reported issues are resolved.
* Compensation based on experience and role fit.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note describing the mobile and web applications you have tested, the tools you have used, and one example of a defect you found and documented.

description:
**Overview**
------------

**About Us**
------------


Synchrony is more than a financial services company, we’re a team of passionate innovators committed to delivering best\-in\-class solutions that support millions of customers across the U.S. With a bold focus on technology, data, and digital innovation, we create meaningful experiences that simplify lives and enable financial wellness.

**Job Description**
-------------------


Job ID
2602362

Technology

09/25/2026  

  

**Role Title :** AVP, Mobile Engineer III \- AI native (L10\)

  

  

**Company Overview:** Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.  

  



**Organizational Overview:**

We are looking for a **Senior AI\-Native Mobile Engineer** with deep expertise in **native iOS engineering** and strong fluency in **Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI\-assisted software engineering practices**.


This is **not a traditional mobile development role**.


This role combines the expectations of a **senior hands\-on iOS technical leader** with the mindset of an **AI\-native engineer** who helps define how modern mobile applications are designed, built, tested, and delivered using A


You will lead the design and development of **high\-quality, secure, scalable mobile experiences**, while also driving adoption of **AI\-powered engineering workflows**, reusable patterns, and platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and technical outcomes across the mobile organization.


You will work at the intersection of:


**Native iOS Engineering \+ Generative AI \+ Agentic AI \+ Developer Productivity \+ Mobile Platform Leadership**

  

  

**Role Summary / Purpose**


The **Senior AI\-Native Mobile Engineer** is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the design, development, and evolution of high\-quality iOS applications and shared mobile capabilities. This role provides hands\-on technical leadership across application architecture, feature delivery, AI\-powered mobile experiences, performance, reliability, security, accessibility, observability, and developer experience.


The role partners closely with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Android engineers, QE leads, backend engineers, architects, and platform teams to deliver scalable, secure, and consistent customer experiences. In addition to strong native mobile engineering depth, this role is expected to actively leverage and champion **AI\-assisted and AI\-native engineering practices** across the software development lifecycle.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**Native Mobile Engineering**


* Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of complex native iOS features and platform capabilities.
* Design and build high\-quality mobile applications using **Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, and Apple’s iOS SDKs**.

Define and* scalable architecture patterns that ensure maintainability, testability, performance, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Build secure, performant, reliable mobile applications with strong attention to accessibility and user experience.
* Integrate backend services using **REST, GraphQL, WebSocket**, and related service patterns.
* Collaborate with backend and platform engineering teams on API contracts, authentication, resiliency, error handling, and service integration requirements.
* Diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving crashes, performance bottlenecks, networking, concurrency, memory management, and application stability.
* Drive best practices for code quality, automated testing, observability, release readiness, and operational excellence.
* Contribute to reusable iOS components, frameworks, SDKs, shared libraries, and mobile platform foundations.
* Partner with Android engineers to promote consistent mobile patterns, shared standards, and cohesive cross\-platform experiences.
  

  

**Generative AI \& Agentic AI**


* Integrate **LLM capabilities** into mobile applications to enable AI\-powered conversational, search, recommendation, and workflow\-driven experiences.
* Build production\-quality mobile experiences powered by **Generative AI and AI agents**.
* Integrate AI models and services such as **OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude**, or enterprise AI platforms.
* Implement **streaming responses, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and multimodal experiences** within mobile applications.
* Build and integrate **AI agents and agentic workflows** that improve customer experience or engineering execution.
* Work with technologies such as **MCP, RAG, LangGraph, LangChain**, or equivalent orchestration frameworks where appropriate.
* Design secure AI architectures covering data handling, context management, authentication, authorization, privacy, and governance.
* Help define practical standards for safe, scalable adoption of AI in mobile applications within a regulated environment.
  

  

**AI\-Native Software Engineering**


* Actively leverage AI tools such as **GitHub Copilot** and other LLM\-based engineering tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and technical discovery.
* Build AI\-powered workflows across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, and code review.
* Explore and develop engineering agents that can interpret Jira stories, analyze codebases, generate implementation plans, and support development workflows.
* Automate repetitive engineering activities using AI agents, developer tools, and intelligent workflows.
* Champion practical AI\-assisted engineering practices while maintaining strong engineering judgment, quality, security, and compliance standards.
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI models, coding assistants, agents, frameworks, and developer productivity tools.
  

  

**Mobile Platform, Engineering Excellence \& Leadership**


* Help establish reusable AI capabilities and engineering patterns across mobile teams.
* Develop common patterns, APIs, SDKs, frameworks, and standards for AI\-powered mobile experiences.
* Improve mobile build and release reliability through contributions to **CI/CD pipelines, build automation, code\-quality gates, security scanning, and deployment workflows**.
* Drive mobile observability through crash analytics, performance monitoring, logging, release\-health metrics, and rollout analysis.
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical spikes, proof\-of\-concepts, and design discussions for foundational mobile capabilities.
* Mentor and coach engineers on **Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, architecture, testing, debugging, and technical decision\-making**.
* Produce clear technical documentation, including design proposals, implementation guidance, architecture decision records, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, PI planning, ART syncs, and cross\-team coordination, identifying and escalating technical risks early.
* Contribute to communities of practice, engineering standards, internal knowledge sharing, and developer experience improvements.

**Required Skills/Knowledge:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and **5\+ years** of relevant experience in Information Technology, or in lieu of a degree, **7\+ years** of relevant experience in Information Technology.
* Strong hands\-on experience in native iOS development, with deep production expertise in **Swift**, **SwiftUI**, **UIKit**, **Xcode**, and **Apple’s iOS SDKs**. Working knowledge of **Android development** concepts, **Kotlin**, and **Jetpack Compose** is good to have.
* Demonstrated experience **designing**, **building**, and supporting production\-scale iOS applications.
* Strong understanding of **iOS architecture patterns**, including **MVVM**, Clean **Architecture**, **modularization**, **dependency injection**, and coordinator\-based navigation, where applicable. Familiarity with **Android architecture** principles is a plus.
* Strong understanding of **performance, security, testing, accessibility, observability, and release engineering** for mobile applications.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with **RESTful APIs, microservices, authentication services, API gateway patterns**, and modern backend services.
* Strong knowledge of **Swift concurrency, async/await, actors, GCD, reactive programming, and asynchronous networking**.
* Experience building reusable **iOS components**, frameworks, SDKs, or shared libraries.
* Hands\-on experience integrating **Generative AI / LLM capabilities** into software applications.
* Experience with **LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, or AI agents**.
* Demonstrated AI fluency, including productive use of **GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI\-assisted development tools**.
* Experience with **CI/CD, build automation, code signing, provisioning, test automation, and release workflows**.
* Strong testing experience including **unit, integration, UI, and automation testing** using tools such as **XCTest and XCUITest**.
* Familiarity with **secure coding practices, static analysis, dependency scanning, and mobile security standards**.
* Working knowledge of **Android architecture and development concepts** to enable effective cross\-platform collaboration.
* Strong analytical, **system design**, **debugging**, **problem\-solving**, and technical communication skills.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and collaborate effectively across teams without direct authority.
* Experience working in **Agile delivery environments at scale**, including **SAFe or similar frameworks**.
* Within the first year, you will help us:
	+ Deliver **production\-quality AI\-powered mobile experiences** on iOS.
	+ Establish reusable patterns for **AI\-native mobile development**.
	+ Lead the implementation of scalable, secure, and maintainable **iOS architecture and platform capabilities**.
	+ Improve engineering quality and speed through **AI\-assisted and agentic development workflows**.
	+ Automate meaningful portions of the mobile software development lifecycle.
	+ Strengthen standards for **mobile architecture, testing, security, observability, and release engineering**.
	+ Improve developer productivity through reusable tooling, frameworks, and AI\-enabled engineering practices.
	+ Help move mobile engineering from **AI\-assisted development to AI\-native engineering**.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**:


* Experience with both **iOS \& Android**.
* Experience with **SwiftUI migration strategies** from UIKit\-based applications.
* Experience with **Jetpack Compose** and broader Android mobile patterns.
* Experience with **OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude**, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience with **MCP, RAG, LangGraph, LangChain**, or similar agent orchestration technologies.
* Experience building **AI agents**, internal developer platforms, or engineering productivity solutions.
* Experience with **mobile CI/CD and build automation** tools such as **Bitrise, Xcode Cloud, Fastlane, GitHub Actions**, or similar.
* Experience with **modular architecture, Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods, dependency management, and versioning strategies**.
* Experience with **on\-device AI, Core ML, Apple Intelligence, ML Kit, MediaPipe**, or local/edge model execution.
* Experience with service virtualization, API mocking, contract testing, and test\-environment management.
* Experience with observability platforms such as **New Relic, Splunk, Datadog, Firebase Crashlytics, CloudWatch**, or similar.
* Experience implementing accessibility aligned with **WCAG and Apple accessibility standards**.
* Experience in **financial services** or other **regulated, security\-sensitive environments**.
* Experience working with distributed, cross\-shore engineering teams across time zones.
* Experience contributing to communities of practice, standards documentation, and technical forums.

**Key Technologies**


**Mobile:** Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, iOS SDK, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK


**AI:** LLMs, Generative AI, AI Agents, RAG, Tool Calling, MCP, Agentic Workflows


**AI Platforms:** OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, enterprise AI platforms


**Engineering:** Git, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, APIs, cloud platforms


**AI Development:** GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, and emerging AI coding/agent platforms


**Work Timings** 2:00PM to 11:00 PM IST


This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may periodically due to business needs).
